description: A dashboard page heading in Svelte 5: an h1 with a scope line, an SvSegmented range switch for 7d, 30d and 90d, and a Download report SvButton, above a row of four SvStat values with deltas and a light bar strip. Switching the range swaps every value, delta and bar. Refund rate uses the SvStat invert prop, so a drop reads as good.
keywords: svelte 5 kpi header with date range

faq.question: How does the range switch change the numbers?
faq.answer: SvSegmented is bound to a range state, and the view is a $derived lookup into a DATA record keyed by range. Each SvStat reads its label, value and delta from that view, so one assignment updates the whole row.

faq.question: Why does the refund rate show pp?
faq.answer: Refund rate is itself a percentage, so its change is in percentage points. The block passes it as a preformatted delta string with an explicit trend, and sets invert so a falling rate is shown green.

faq.question: How do I load real numbers?
faq.answer: Replace the DATA record with a fetch keyed by range, for example in a SvelteKit load that reads the range from the URL, and keep the same { kpis, bars } shape.
